review.method: Exact primary degree and individual course bodies; shared curriculum blocks independently re-proven. Outside eligibility and placement are reviewed separately.

quotes.text: Some courses can be used to satisfy requirements in more than one category, but each course may only be used once in a degree.

institutionMinCredits.scope: Standard nonmilitary 15-credit AC, OL/NU, GS or e-Pack course-residency route.

externalMaxCredits.scope: Derived bound for the selected standard-residency route, not a universal transfer guarantee.
externalMaxCredits.calculation: 120 degree credits minus 15 TESU course-residency credits.

alternativeMaxCredits.scope: Combined ACE/NCCRS, CLEP, DSST, AP, military/corporate training and other approved noncollegiate credit.

upperMinCredits.scope: At least 12 upper-level credits in the area of study, the upper-level capstone, and an additional three upper-level credits in the area of study or Professional Business Requirements. The six chosen area courses are upper level.

gradePolicy.detail: Composition, Professional Business Requirements and this degree’s area of study require C or better. Other general education and electives retain their applicable grade rules.

transferPolicyReview.alternativeMaxScope: Combined noncollegiate sources; not 90 credits per provider.
transferPolicyReview.residencyNote: Standard nonmilitary 15-credit eligible-course residency; exams alone do not fulfill it. Edison Accelerate and military alternatives are separate scenarios.

graduationRequirements.title: Minimum overall GPA
graduationRequirements.description: Maintain at least a 2.0 overall GPA and satisfy the applicable area-of-study and composition grade requirements.

providerEligibilityReview.scope: Provider review status only, independent of receiving-course equivalencies, exact degree placement, source recommendation periods and an individual student credit award. Provider review status establishes neither student enrollment permission nor a prohibition.

modelFields.coverageLabel: Complete current degree curriculum with exact receiving-course and degree-placement evidence.

groups.title: B.S.B.A. in Human Resources/Organizational Management area of study

rulesNotes: 45 general education + 42 Professional Business Requirements + 18 area of study + 15 free electives = 120 semester credits.
The two selected Human Cultures choices are HIS-1140 and PHI-1300. Scientific category alternatives require independently published classification, not a course-title similarity.
The catalog label identifies the same receiving catalog as the existing exact course awards. This exact degree’s primary body, capture hash and November 26 review date are recorded separately.
The standard nonmilitary 15-credit eligible-course residency and 90-credit combined noncollegiate cap remain distinct. Cornerstone and capstone are taken at TESU.
At least half of the business area of study must be current within ten years of the most recent application date; the business capstone has a five-year currency limit.

unresolved.message: Have TESU apply your enrollment catalog and evaluate any previous coursework.
If you use military benefits or Edison Accelerate, select the residency route that applies to you.

pricingNotes: Tuition comparisons use the separately dated published TESU tuition source. Books, provider checkout taxes and individual fees are separate from course-credit eligibility.

tuitionComparison.reviewScope: The exact current degree identity is bound to the retained standard undergraduate tuition comparison. The November 25 price-source review and amounts are unchanged; no new price review is claimed.
